title: Influence of Stimulation Parameters on the Analgesic Effect of High-Frequency Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation on Neuropathic Pain: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
title_zh: 高频经颅磁刺激治疗神经病理性疼痛的刺激参数影响：系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: BACKGROUND: There is a need for novel analgesic treatments in patients with chronic neuropathic pain. High-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (HF-rTMS) may have a clinically significant pain reducing effect. The aim of this study was to evaluate the therapeutic effects of HF-rTMS on chronic neuropathic pain and to investigate the influence of different stimulation parameters. METHODS: A systematic search in PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science was performed. Thirty-one studies were included. RESULTS: HF-rTMS delivered to the precentral cortex (PreCC) with a focal F8-coil showed a significant analgesic effect (SMD = -0.86, 95% CI [-1.34, -0.37] and SMD = -0.80, 95% CI [-1.39, -0.20], for 3-5-session and >5-session datasets, respectively). HF-rTMS delivered to the PreCC with a larger H-coil also showed a significant effect (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI [-0.65, -0.08]), whereas HF-rTMS delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex did not (SMD = -0.29, 95% CI [-0.93, 0.34]). Exploratory subgroup analyses did not show statistically significant differences between levels of stimulation frequency, intensity, number of pulses per session, or number of sessions, except for stimulation intensity in the >5-session dataset with the largest effect observed at 80% of the resting motor threshold. Regarding the effects of HF-rTMS of the PreCC, some parameters reached statistical significance at individual level: stimulation frequency (10 Hz in both datasets; 20 Hz in the 3-5-session dataset only), stimulation intensity (80% of the resting motor threshold), and number of pulses per session (1200-1600 in the >5-session dataset; 2000-2500 in the 3-5-session dataset). However, these individual-level significances do not formally establish a difference between subgroups, given that the corresponding comparison tests were not statistically significant. CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis supports the overall efficacy of HF-rTMS of the PreCC for relieving chronic neuropathic pain. However, given substantial study heterogeneity, statistical limitations, reliance on few or influential studies for several parameter levels, and correlation between parameters across studies, parameter-specific findings should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than evidence of established parameter-response relationships. These results underscore the need for well-powered, systematically designed trials that directly compare stimulation protocols before optimal strategies can be established.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性神经病理性疼痛患者需要新的镇痛治疗方法。高频重复经颅磁刺激（HF-rTMS）可能具有临床显著的镇痛效果。本研究旨在评估HF-rTMS对慢性神经病理性疼痛的治疗效果，并探讨不同刺激参数的影响。方法：在PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science中进行了系统检索。共纳入31项研究。结果：使用焦点F8线圈对预中央皮层（PreCC）进行的HF-rTMS显示出显著镇痛效果（3-5次治疗数据集：SMD = -0.86，95% CI [-1.34, -0.37]；>5次治疗数据集：SMD = -0.80，95% CI [-1.39, -0.20]）。使用较大H线圈对PreCC进行的HF-rTMS也显示出显著效果（SMD = -0.36，95% CI [-0.65, -0.08]），而对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层进行的HF-rTMS未显示显著效果（SMD = -0.29，95% CI [-0.93, 0.34]）。探索性亚组分析显示，刺激频率、强度、每次治疗脉冲数或治疗次数的不同水平之间没有统计学显著差异，唯一的例外是>5次治疗数据集中的刺激强度，最大效应观察于静息运动阈值的80%。关于PreCC受HF-rTMS影响的效应，个体水平上某些参数达到了统计学显著性：刺激频率（两个数据集中均为10 Hz；仅3-5次治疗数据集中为20 Hz）、刺激强度（静息运动阈值的80%）以及每次治疗脉冲数（>5次治疗数据集中为1200-1600；3-5次治疗数据集中为2000-2500）。然而，这些个体水平的显著性并未正式确立亚组之间的差异，因为相应的比较检验未达到统计学显著性。结论：本荟萃分析支持HF-rTMS对PreCC进行治疗以缓解慢性神经病理性疼痛的总体有效性。然而，鉴于显著的研究异质性、统计学局限性、某些参数水平依赖于少数或有影响力的研究以及跨研究之间参数的相关性，参数特异性的发现应被视为生成假设的依据，而非确立参数-反应关系的证据。这些结果强调需要进行统计效力充足、系统设计合理的试验，直接比较刺激方案，才能确定最佳策略。
